policy.rf_vocabulary: RF Vocabulary owns rf.concept.* and rf.context.*; adoptions require individual justification (target spec §6).
policy.replacement: Pre-v0.1 core catalog and promotions are replaced; the RF Vocabulary is fixed and embedded.

limitations: Coverage and boundary evidence is provider-surface research; it does not prove semantic completeness of representations.
RF Vocabulary adoptions are derived from the current dialect sources and individually justifiable per target spec §6.
